About me

Hi, I’m Haoming.

I’m Haoming Gu (Henry), a Ph.D. student at the Research Center for Social Computing and Interactive Robotics (HIT-SCIR), Harbin Institute of Technology. I’m interested in how robots can learn from experience, generalize across tasks and environments, and adapt to the physical world. My long-term goal is to develop capable and reliable robots that can assist people in everyday life.

Outside of research, I enjoy snowboarding 🏂, swimming 🏊, Counter-Strike 2 🎮. I’m also a fan of Karina.
